title: [CHALLENGE-TASK-05] Challenge Publication & Ownership Protection Endpoint
objective: Expose challenge creation and edition endpoints, enforcing strict company ownership (RB-06 / RF15) and limiting modifications to Draft or Open states.
specs:
- Endpoints:
  * POST /api/v1/challenges/: Create challenge for authenticated COMPANY (201 Created)
  * GET /api/v1/challenges/{id}: Private full challenge details for owner
  * PATCH /api/v1/challenges/{id}: Update challenge details
- Business Rules:
  * Only users with role COMPANY can create challenges
  * RB-06: Companies can only edit their own challenges (company_id == user.id), returning HTTP 403 Forbidden if another company attempts access
  * RB-06: Modifications only permitted while challenge is in DRAFT or OPEN status (HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity if IN_PROGRESS or CLOSED)
- Target Files: src/routers/challenges.py, src/services/challenge_service.py
deliverables:
- [ ] POST /api/v1/challenges/ route with company role requirement
- [ ] Ownership verification service logic protecting PATCH and GET routes
- [ ] State mutability check blocking edits on closed or in-progress challenges
- [ ] Integration tests verifying successful creation, 403 ownership rejection, and state locking
